verdict.rationale: A first-party GitHub repository (github.com/nottelabs/notte) is cited, which suggests some of Notte's source is publicly readable. The evidence never names a license or says which parts of the product, such as the cloud browser infrastructure, are in that repo. One community comment wishing it were open source is only a question, not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented open-source license, confirmation of which product components are published, independent corroboration of the repo's contents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
